description: This file defines the 'Immigration' Data Transfer Object (DTO) class within the OrangeHRM project. It facilitates the normalization and retrieval of immigration-related employee data, including passport details and documentation, for reporting purposes.

classes.name: Immigration
classes.description: Data Transfer Object (DTO) for employee immigration information, providing normalized access to immigration details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Immigration DTO with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the immigration records of an employee into a normalized array based on specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Defines the mapping between field names and their respective getter methods for data extraction.
